limits: Right side only; the left popliteal fossa was not run.

The popliteal ARTERY is shipped from y = -307 (just below the adductor hiatus at the lower border of her adductor magnus, y = -305) to y = -386, about 11 mm past the knee joint line (femur ends at y = -401, tibia starts at -394). Its division at the lower border of popliteus (y = -490) is NOT covered: below y ~ -390 the paired walk could not be verified on the montage - the lumina lie deep between the heads of gastrocnemius and the masks ran into muscle.
The popliteal VEIN is shipped only to y = -360; between -360 and -386 every level failed the cleaning gate (ragged or out-of-band), so the vein of the distal fossa is not covered.

Diameters are LUMEN diameters (the dark clotted blood), not vessel calibre: the artery measures a median 4.3 mm against a textbook 5-8 mm (post-mortem contraction of the muscular wall plus the mask stopping at the dark core), and the vein 5.5 mm against 7-11 mm (a cadaveric vein carries no pressure and is collapsed). Both are reported as measured, not forced to the textbook band.

The TIBIAL NERVE is shipped over y -340 .. -374 only (21 verified levels). It is not a duplicate of the shipped sciatic track (vhf_nerves_cryo.nii.gz ends at y = -235). Above y = -340 the fascicle detector fired on 2 levels only, and those two were discarded.
The COMMON FIBULAR NERVE was attempted and is not shipped: 13 of 32 levels over 31 mm, which is not unambiguous.

The corridor and the landmarks (femur popliteal surface, adductor magnus lower border, popliteus lower border) come from TRANSFERRED meshes, so they are approximate; the corridor only rejects far-away blobs.
Nothing here is a segmentation of the vessel wall or of the epineurium.

verification.depth_rule: +Z is anterior: the popliteal artery (deepest, on the femur and the knee capsule) must have the largest mean z, then the popliteal vein, then the tibial nerve (most superficial).
